question: What must be locked before an MCP release can receive a behavioral recommendation?
intended_takeaway: Qualify exact MCP revisions as whole Agent-facing releases.
out_of_scope: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

placement.what_to_watch: Track exact main and final staging through observed zero-model reconciliation, an unrun 8-cell canary, a conditional 16-cell confirmation, and the package HOLD.

claims.claim: Zero-model preparation locked the two reviewed revisions.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

claims.claim: Descriptions, projections, pagination, and errors are behavioral inputs.
support: Target-platform probes record the exact tool manifest.
Protocol compatibility alone cannot establish Agent compatibility.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

claims.claim: Immutable source evidence stays separate from Study output.
support: Receipt passed: 2 roots, 18 direct children, 16 prediction rows.
No model ran and no result Calls were published.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

claims.claim: An 8-cell canary gates a separate 16-cell confirmation.
support: Claude Code and the locked route stay fixed.
The confirmation needs its own preview, approval, budget, and result.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

claims.claim: Behavioral evidence cannot issue package GO.
support: The Study supports a bounded local behavior summary.
Package release still needs independent checks and human sign-off.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

claims.claim: Four outcome layers remain independently inspectable.
support: Conformance, deterministic, judgment, and mechanism answer different questions.
A release memo cannot hide failure in an aggregate.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.

claims.claim: A real mechanism fix still leaves the package on HOLD.
support: Main reported 18 rows; staging reported the correct 16.
No Agent canary, confirmation, or package sign-off is reported.
claims.caveat: Required evidence is not yet observed.

claims.claim: An MCP release spans design, execution, evidence, and decision.
support: The whole locked release is the treatment.
No individual staging feature receives causal credit.
claims.caveat: Zero-model conformance is not an Agent behavioral result or a package release decision.
